output: Scored this Y2K baby tee with the cutest butterfly print on Depop for only $18 and I am obsessed. I'm styling it with baggy straight-leg jeans, chunky white sneakers, and a cropped zip hoodie for the ultimate nostalgic streetwear moment. Such a dreamy little vintage find!

Scored this vintage light wash cropped denim jacket on Poshmark for only $42, and I'm already obsessed. Throwing it on over a black zip hoodie with wide-leg khaki trousers and combat boots for the ultimate 90s streetwear vibe. It’s definitely going to be my new daily go-to jacket!

Scored these chunky platform sneakers on Poshmark for just $48 and I am obsessed. They are bringing all the Y2K street vibes to my closet today. Can't wait to style them with a cropped hoodie and baggy jeans.

Scored this absolute dream of a Y2K baby tee with the cutest butterfly print on Depop for just $18! I'm so obsessed with the nostalgic streetwear energy it brings, especially paired with baggy dark wash jeans and chunky sneakers. It’s giving effortless retro vibes, but I can't wait to style it with wide-leg trousers for a cool, casual contrast too.

Just scored these khaki low-rise cargo pants on Poshmark for only $27, and I am obsessed. I'm totally leaning into the ultimate 2000s streetwear vibe by pairing them with a white ribbed tank, an unzipped black cropped hoodie, and chunky sneakers. Such a good secondhand win!

Score this 2003 tour bootleg style graphic tee on Depop for just $24 and I'm honestly obsessed. I'm styling it with dark wash baggy jeans and combat boots for that effortless 90s grunge vibe. Total instant favorite in my rotation.

Scored this black mesh long-sleeve top on Depop for just $15 and I am so obsessed with it. It’s got that ultimate 90s goth-grunge energy and is going to be my new go-to for layering. Can’t wait to style it with baggy dark denim and combat boots for a moody look, or throw a cropped zip hoodie over it with wide-leg trousers for peak Y2K contrast.

Just scored these vintage Levi's 501 jeans on Depop for only $38 and I am never taking them off. They have that perfect broken-in feel for throwing on with a white tank and chunky sneakers for casual streetwear days. Already planning to style them with a cropped hoodie and combat boots too for a little bit of edge.

Scored this chunky brown knit cardigan on Depop for just $35 and it’s basically a wearable hug. I'm so obsessed with the cozy earth-tone vibe that I've already planned two ways to wear it—either thrown over wide-leg trousers for that rustic neutral look, or buttoned up with dark wash denim and combat boots for some edgy cottagecore energy. Definitely my new favorite fall staple!

Just scored this oversized red and black plaid flannel shirt on thredUp for only $22, and it's already my new favorite layering piece. I’m leaning hard into the 90s grunge vibe today, wearing it open over a white ribbed tank with baggy dark wash jeans and black combat boots. It also looks so good buttoned up with wide-leg khakis and chunky sneakers for that effortless streetwear look.
